_note: pipeline-lead-rotation. LeadRotationService assigns a new lead without an assignee to the eligible colleague with the fewest leads in 30 days when app config lead_rotation_enabled is true. agentProfile gains a 30-day cap and a pause switch (1.1.0); lead gains the read-only assignmentReason (1.8.0). Named to merge after the last lead fragment so its version wins.

leadCapPer30Days.title: Lead cap per 30 days
leadCapPer30Days.description: The most leads this colleague receives through automatic assignment in 30 days. Empty means no cap.

pauseLeadAssignment.title: Pause lead assignment
pauseLeadAssignment.description: While on, this colleague receives no leads through automatic assignment.

assignmentReason.title: Assignment reason
assignmentReason.description: Why automatic assignment gave this lead to its owner, or why it found nobody.
